description: This Java class 'HibernateUtil' provides utility methods for Hibernate ORM integration, such as dialect detection, SQL wildcard escaping, proxy unproxying, batch retrieval, and criteria predicate construction within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: HibernateUtil
classes.description: Utility class for Hibernate ORM operations, including dialect detection, SQL escaping, unproxying, entity retrieval by UUID, batch scroll queries, and criteria predicate construction.

methods.name: isHSQLDialect
methods.description: Checks if the current Hibernate dialect is HSQLDialect.

methods.name: isPostgreSQLDialect
methods.description: Checks if the current Hibernate dialect is PostgreSQL82Dialect.

methods.name: getDialect
methods.description: Retrieves the Hibernate dialect for a given SessionFactory.

methods.name: escapeSqlWildcards
methods.description: Escapes SQL wildcards in a string, tailored for the current database connection.

methods.name: getAttributePredicate
methods.description: Constructs attribute-based predicates for JPA criteria queries for filtering Location entities.

methods.name: getRealObjectFromProxy
methods.description: Unproxies a Hibernate proxy object to get the actual entity instance.

methods.name: getUniqueEntityByUUID
methods.description: Retrieves a unique entity by its UUID using Criteria API.

methods.name: getScrollableResult
methods.description: Creates a ScrollableResults object for batch processing entities.
